title: 第9章 修炼不如钓鱼第10章 逸风潜龙诀
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: “这事哪能怪我嘛！”
郑常一脸无赖样，眯着眼坐在小板凳上，看着水里的浮标随着波浪荡漾。
在垂星瀑布底下折腾了一番，身子骨都要散架了。
先歇两天，恢复过来再继续玩。歇着的时候正好钓鱼，能吃又能玩，一举两得。
敖青气愤道：“谁能想到你就是一个炼气一层的弱鸡啊！你要早说，怎么我也等到你筑基了我再和你契约啊。”
“瞧你说的像是我逼你似的。我在上面好好的观光，是哪个莫名其妙龙吸水，把我吸到下面去的？最后差点没给我淹死！”
敖青气的不行，却也无法反驳，青色的鳞片都要气成紫色了。
“你！啊！那你速速去弄些灵石来修炼，尽快筑基，我也能尽快恢复龙族血脉，对你也有好处。”
【是啊是啊，宿主，你就听听你这新灵宠的话吧，有它辅助你，你修炼起来事半功倍的。】
系统也在一旁撺掇道，虽然敖青察觉不到系统的存在，但系统已经将这个会帮她督促宿主修炼的小蛇当成同伙了。
可惜，郑常油盐不进。
“今天丹田有点不舒服，应该是伤还没好，再休息两天。”
“伤汝母个头！”敖青气不过，大骂起来，随后蹿进水里，搅动水流，直接将马上就要咬钩的鱼全都吓跑了。
一般钓鱼佬这会儿就要烧水做蛇肉羹了。
不过郑常并不在意，他从早上睡醒就开始钓，此刻太阳都快要下山了。郑常的鱼护里早已经装满了了十多条鱼了。
算上昨天钓上来的几条，烤熟了往系统空间一放，接下来几天都不用吃干饼了。
郑常拉起鱼护，鱼护里十几条鱼，少说了三十斤，加上鱼护本身的重量和挂着的水的重量，还真不轻。
可他和拎空鱼护一样轻松，利用系统灵泉的灵气，郑常在今早突破练气五层的修为，给郑常的力量带来了肉眼可见的提升。
“小青，别闹了！回来吃饭了！”
“别叫老子小青！我是倒了八辈子血霉了！”
“那杀鱼剩下的鱼胆你还要不要嘛！”
可恶啊！我堂堂风龙一族敖青，怎么落得这么个地步！
给战利品们开膛破肚，将鱼胆逗狗一样抛给敖青，惹得他一阵恼怒。
处理好后，又用清水冲洗掉血沫，郑常将鲜鱼统统用竹签串起来，架在火上烤了起来。
有一说一，修仙还是有不少好处的。
练气一层的时候还没觉得，现在练气五层，又通过敖青的灵兽契约，学来了一些五行术法。
像这篝火，也不用拿打火机点了，引出一道灵火就能将木柴点着，就算木柴有点湿也能点着，比凡火强上太多了。
烤鱼吃鱼，将烤焦的鱼丢给敖青加餐，天色早就已经暗了下来了。
郑常熟练的从系统空间拿出帐篷铺盖，就准备休息了。
穿越过来，没有手机玩，也不用上班，每天都能日出而作日落而息，睡个十小时，真的是舒服得很。
郑常感觉自己现在整个人都容光焕发，毛发都旺盛了。
“你就打算休息了？”敖青不解道。
昨日他就是这么早休息的。他当郑常前天在溶洞里折腾，累坏了。
结果今天他又这么早睡？明明钓鱼的时候龙精虎猛，提竿的时候都中气十足，不像是虚了啊，怎么还这么早睡？
每日的修行不做了？怎么不冥想吐纳灵气？
“对啊，你不睡吗？怕冷？我倒是不介意你进帐篷来，但别进我被窝，我怕你半夜睡迷糊了咬我，也怕翻身压着你。”
“你不做功课了？”
“什么功课，我又不是学生。”
content_en:
"How can you blame me for this!"
Zheng Chang looked like a rogue and sat on the small bench with squinted eyes, watching the buoys in the water ripple with the waves.
After struggling a lot under the Chuixing Waterfall, my body almost fell apart.
Take a couple of days off to recover before continuing to play. During the rest period, I happened to be fishing. I could eat and play, killing two birds with one stone.
Ao Qing said angrily: "Who would have thought that you are just a weakling at the first level of Qi Refining! If you had told me earlier, why would I wait until you established the foundation before I made a contract with you?"
"Look, you said it as if I was forcing you. I was enjoying the sightseeing up there, but some mysterious dragon sucked the water and sucked me down below? I almost didn't drown in the end!"
Ao Qing was so angry that he couldn't refute, and his blue scales almost turned purple with anger.
"You! Ah! Then you quickly get some spiritual stones to practice and build the foundation as soon as possible. I can also restore the dragon bloodline as soon as possible. It will also be good for you."
[Yes, yes, host, just listen to the words of your new spiritual pet. With its help, your cultivation will get twice the result with half the effort. 】
The system also encouraged Ao Qing from the side. Although Ao Qing was not aware of the existence of the system, the system had regarded this little snake who would help her supervise the host's cultivation as an accomplice.
It's a pity that Chang Zheng can't get enough oil and salt.
"I feel a little uncomfortable in my dantian today. It's probably because my injury hasn't healed yet. I need to rest for two more days."
"It hurts your mother's size!" Ao Qing was furious and cursed, then jumped into the water, stirred the water flow, and scared away all the fish that were about to bite the hook.
Normally a fisherman would have to boil water to make snake soup.
But Zheng Chang didn't care. He had been fishing since he woke up in the morning. The sun was almost setting at this moment. Zheng Chang's fish cage was already filled with more than ten fish.
Counting the few fish caught yesterday, once cooked and placed in the system space, there will be no need to eat dry biscuits in the next few days.
Zheng Chang pulled up the fish guard. There were more than a dozen fish in the fish guard, weighing less than thirty kilograms. Adding the weight of the fish guard itself and the weight of the water hanging in it, it was really not light.
But he was as easy as carrying Kong Yuhu. Using the aura of the system's spiritual spring, Zheng Chang broke through the fifth level of Qi training this morning, which brought a visible improvement to Zheng Chang's strength.
"Xiaoqing, stop making trouble! Come back for dinner!"
"Don't call me Xiaoqing! I've had bad luck for eight lifetimes!"
"Then do you still want the fish gall left over from the fish?"
"...want it!"
Damn it! How could I, Ao Qing, a noble member of the Wind Dragon clan, end up in such a situation!
He disemboweled the trophies and threw the fish gall to Ao Qing like a dog, making him angry for a while.
After processing, he rinsed away the blood foam with clean water. Zheng Chang strung all the fresh fish on bamboo skewers and grilled them over the fire.
There is one thing to say, there are still many benefits to cultivating immortality.
I didn't feel it when I was at the first level of Qi training. Now I am at the fifth level of Qi training, and I have learned some Five Elements techniques through Ao Qing's spirit beast contract.
Like this bonfire, you don't need to use a lighter to light it. You can light the firewood by drawing out a spiritual fire. Even if the firewood is a little wet, it can still be lit. It is much stronger than ordinary fire.
After grilling the fish and eating the fish, he threw the burnt fish to Ao Qing for a snack. The sky had already darkened.
Zheng Chang skillfully took out the tent and bedding from the system space and was ready to rest.
When I traveled back in time, I didn’t have mobile phones to play with, and I didn’t have to go to work. I could sleep from sunrise to sunset every day, and sleep for ten hours. It was really comfortable.
Zheng Chang felt that his whole body was radiant now and his hair was growing thicker.
"Are you planning to take a rest?" Ao Qing asked confused.
That's how early he went to bed yesterday. He thought that Zheng Chang was exhausted from tossing in the cave the day before yesterday.
So he went to bed so early today? I was obviously very energetic when I was fishing, and I was full of energy when I lifted the rod. It didn’t look like I was weak. Why did I go to bed so early?
No more daily practice? Why don't you meditate and breathe out the spiritual energy?
"That's right. Aren't you going to sleep? Afraid of the cold? I don't mind you coming into the tent, but don't get into my bed. I'm afraid you'll bite me if you fall asleep in the middle of the night, or I'm afraid you'll turn over and crush you."
"You don't do your homework?"
"What kind of homework? I'm not a student."
title_en: Chapter 9: Cultivation is not as good as fishing Chapter 10: The Art of Yifeng Hidden Dragon
